rationale: Add exact dyadic dot-sign predicates and likelihood recession witnesses with explicit incomplete axis screening, separate from numerical convergence. Add optional sequential Faer thin-SVD least squares and Gaussian numerical rank/residual/scale assessment with declared cutoffs and no covariance or exact-rank guarantee. Forward the existing facade faer feature to distributions and qualify its actual feature API; native likelihood and sampler defaults remain unchanged.
